request.prompt:
Describe actual visible changes in chronological RGB frames. Bind entities across time. Record at most three persistent changes or reversals and a neutral initial scene context. Robot-only motion, camera movement and occlusion are not automatically environment changes. Do not infer purpose, utility, completion or a task plan. Return only JSON. Exact keys context, changes, coverage. context is one neutral first-scene sentence max 240 characters. changes at most 3 items; exact keys b, a, object, before, after. b and a are supplied evidence IDs, time(b)<time(a). object/before/after each max 160 characters; brief visible descriptions. coverage=complete|overflow|occluded|no_observable_change. Host assigns change numbers and looks up timestamps; do not generate entity IDs or timestamps.
EVIDENCE_TIME_MS: {"c0a":3000,"c0b":2000,"c1a":6000,"c1b":5000,"f0000":0,"f0002":2000,"f0003":3000,"f0005":5000,"f0008":8000,"f0011":11000,"f0012":12000,"f0014":14000}

changes.before: robot arm visible, partially occluding table
